eventDetail.scope: NGICSP 2027 will serve as a global academic platform for advancing next-generation intelligent communication and signal processing. It covers core research areas including 5G-A/6G sensing integration, air-ground and satellite communication, AI-based resource scheduling, and semantic communication. It also focuses on key intelligent signal processing technologies, such as multimodal signal analysis, intelligent anti-interference, edge signal optimization, generative AI signal processing, signal compensation, and sensor fusion. Furthermore, it explores antenna beamforming, transmission encryption, privacy protection, and malicious signal identification technologies. The conference will hold keynote speeches and technical sessions to promote global academic and industrial cooperation. It enables researchers to share frontier achievements and conduct professional exchanges, boosting technological innovation and practical applications in intelligent communication and signal processing.
